question: Who did the Indian men's team defeat in the final of the ISTAF Sepak Takraw World Cup?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Japan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India Wins Gold in Men’s Sepak Takraw World Cup, Women Bag Bronze.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India’s men’s team** won the **gold** medal in the **ISTAF Sepak Takraw World Cup 2025**, defeating **Japan** in the final.

 
 
• 
 
**India’s women’s team** secured the **bronze** medal, losing to **Vietnam** in the semi-finals.

 
 
• 
 
In the men’s category, **Iran** and **Singapore** won the **joint bronze** medals.

 
 
• 
 
**Thailand** won the **gold** in the women’s category, and **Vietnam** won the **silver**.

 
 
• 
 
India won a total of **7 medals** at the event, a significant improvement compared to the **5** medals won in the previous World Cup.

 
 
• 
 
**Patna, Bihar** was the first-time host of the **Sepak Takraw World Cup**.
